name: Mitsubishi A6M Zero
blurb: The Imperial Navy's carrier fighter and the game's first hostile airframe.
history:
The Mitsubishi A6M, the Navy Type 0 carrier fighter, served the Imperial Japanese Navy from 1940 to 1945. Its pilots called it the Reisen, the zero fighter, after the last digit of the imperial year 2600 (1940); the Allied reporting name was "Zeke". When it appeared it was considered the most capable carrier fighter in the world, combining maneuverability, speed, firepower and very long range.

By mid-1942 new Allied tactics and equipment let pilots meet it on equal terms. It had no armor or self-sealing tanks, and without boosted controls it was hard to maneuver at high speed. By 1944 it was outdated, yet it stayed in front-line service to the end of the war, late in the war in kamikaze attacks, and Japan built more Zeros than any other combat aircraft.
